primaryRootCause.title: Payment Service Failure (Fatal worker process crash (SIGSEGV/OOM). Service is offline.)
primaryRootCause.mechanism: Fatal worker process crash (SIGSEGV/OOM). Service is offline.

evidenceList.description: Observed error rate elevated by 99.8 percentage points above baseline
Response time SLA breached. Observed p95 is 5000ms vs nominal 35ms
Crash signature matched in stdout/stderr: "FATAL [SIGSEGV]: Worker process died unexpectedly. Uncaught memory panic in thread 0x4B9F."

alternativeHypotheses.title: Order Service Failure (High error rate deadlock)

evidenceList.description: Observed error rate elevated by 59.9 percentage points above baseline
Response time SLA breached. Observed p95 is 4280ms vs nominal 35ms

alternativeHypotheses.title: API Gateway Failure (High error rate deadlock)

evidenceList.description: Observed error rate elevated by 41.9 percentage points above baseline
Response time SLA breached. Observed p95 is 3449ms vs nominal 35ms

alternativeHypotheses.missingEvidenceNotes: Upstream gateway errors appear to be cascading symptoms from deeper dependencies.

investigation.confidenceExplanation: Primary hypothesis ranked #1 with 98% confidence score based on topological root proximity, anomalous error rate deviation (60 pts), and log signature correlation.
investigation.uncertaintyNotes: Network packet captures and distributed traces confirm deep causal impact; transient kernel buffer drops were ruled out due to steady interface TX/RX rates.
investigation.recommendedNextStep: Execute verified recovery action 'RESTART_SERVICE' targeting payment-service. Run post-action verification window of 6s to confirm stabilization.

primaryPlan.title: Graceful restart of payment-service container
primaryPlan.description: Sends SIGTERM, flushes pending in-flight requests, spins up a fresh container instance with clean heap state.
primaryPlan.expectedImpact: Temporary 2-3s transient blip for in-flight requests; immediate resolution of thread deadlocks and OOM states.
